title: Add AgentToll to Base ecosystem
head: tevfikefeaydin:add-agenttoll
body:
Adds AgentToll to the ecosystem page.

AgentToll is a pay-per-call data API for AI agents, built on Base and paid in USDC via x402 (HTTP 402): Base gas, token prices by contract address, wallet portfolios valued in USD, token safety checks, a spam-filtered new-token radar, Basename resolution, and stateless watch endpoints. No API keys or accounts; every endpoint is indexed in the x402 Bazaar and on x402scan, settled through the Coinbase CDP facilitator on Base mainnet.

- Live: https://agenttoll.app
- Open source (MIT): https://github.com/tevfikefeaydin/agenttoll
- Onchain identity: agenttoll.base.eth
